text: He is Allah, glory be to Him and exalted be He, the One worshipped in truth, who has no deity other than Him, Knower of the secret and the public, knowing what is hidden and what is present, He is the Most Merciful whose mercy encompasses everything, the Most Compassionate to the people of faith in Him.
